skills.name: Silver Bolt
skills.text: Fire a silver-tipped bolt for {dmg} damage, {unholyPct}% more against Unholy foes.

variants.name: Blessed Silver
variants.text: The bolt deals Holy Fire damage and sets the foe Burning.

skills.name: Steady Aim
skills.text: If you did not move last turn, you deal {dmgPct}% more damage and gain {accuracy} accuracy.

skills.name: Piercing Shot
skills.text: Fire a bolt that pierces every foe in a line out to your weapon's range, dealing {dmg} damage to each.

variants.name: Ricochet
variants.text: Instead of piercing, the bolt bounces to {bounces} more foes.

variants.name: Heavy Bolt
variants.text: Every foe hit is knocked back {knockback} tiles.

variants.name: Splinter
variants.text: Where the bolt stops it bursts into a cone of splinters reaching {coneRange} tiles further, striking for {splinterPct}% of its damage.

skills.name: Volley
skills.text: Loose {bolts} bolts at up to {bolts} foes in sight for {dmg} damage each.

variants.name: Hail
variants.text: Loose {bolts} bolts that fall on random foes within {spread} tiles of your target.

variants.name: Focus
variants.text: Every bolt flies at one foe, with {critPct}% more critical chance.

variants.name: Pinning
variants.text: Every foe hit is Rooted for {rootTurns} turn.

skills.name: Death Warrant
skills.text: Serve a Death Warrant on a foe within {range} tiles for {turns} turns: your next {hits} Marksman shots that hit it are critical hits.

variants.name: Contagious
variants.text: If the foe dies while Warranted, the warrant passes to the nearest foe.

variants.name: Bounty
variants.text: A foe that dies Warranted pays a bounty: a purse with {bountyPct}% more gold and one more item, rolled with {bountyPct}% more Magic Find.

skills.name: Hunter's Patience
skills.text: The critical hits of your Marksman shots deal {critDmgPct}% more damage. At ranks 3 and 5 your crossbow reaches one tile further ({rangeBonus} now).

skills.name: Execution Shot
skills.text: Take aim for {channel} turns, then fire for {dmg} damage, a sure critical hit against a Warranted foe. A countdown along the line warns of the shot.

variants.name: Overpenetrate
variants.text: The shot pierces every foe in its line.

variants.name: Swift Verdict
variants.text: Aim for only {channel} turn, but the shot deals less: {dmg} damage.

skills.name: Warrant Served
skills.text: A skill that kills a Warranted foe gives back the time it took and restores {manaPct}% of your max Mana.

strings.tree.desc: Keep your distance and your line of sight: steady shots, warrants and executions.
strings.buff.warrant.name: Death Warrant
strings.buff.warrant.desc: This creature's death has been ordered. The Witch Hunter's next Marksman shots that hit it are critical hits. Shots left: {count}. Turns left: {turns}.
strings.buff.aiming.name: Taking Aim
strings.buff.aiming.desc: You steady the crossbow and hold your breath. The shot looses in {turns} turns.
strings.refuse.no_foe: No foe stands on that line.
